# Termux-Playwright Full Technical Specification (v1.81.1)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Non-Root Chromium Browser Automation & Stealth Runtime for Android Termux
Controls genuine Chromium processes via direct Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) WebSocket sessions on Android Bionic libc without root.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-playwright
- Command: pip install termux-playwright && termux-playwright-install
# or: npm install -g termux-playwright
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-playwright
